description: This file defines SIMD vector classes and operations for integer types using AVX2 intrinsics, supporting vectorized arithmetic, logical, and data manipulation operations optimized for CPU capabilities.

classes.name: Vectorizedi
classes.description: Base class for 256-bit integer vectors utilizing AVX2 intrinsics, providing basic inversion and type conversion.

classes.name: Vectorized<int64_t>
classes.description: Specialized vector class for 64-bit integers, including constructors, blend, arange, load/store, and comparison operators.

classes.name: Vectorized<int32_t>
classes.description: Vector class for 32-bit integers with constructors, blend, arange, load/store, reduction, comparison operators, and arithmetic operations.

classes.name: Vectorized<int16_t>
classes.description: Vector class for 16-bit integers with similar capabilities as above, supporting SIMD operations and conversions.

classes.name: Vectorized<int8_t>
classes.description: Vector class for 8-bit signed integers, supporting negation, absolute value, comparison, and other SIMD operations.

classes.name: Vectorized<uint8_t>
classes.description: Vector class for 8-bit unsigned integers with SIMD operations tailored for unsigned data.

classes.name: Vectorized8<T>
classes.description: Template class for 8-bit integer vectors with support for blend, load, store, and shift operations relative to T.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Inverts bits in a __m256i integer vector by XOR with all ones.

methods.name: is_vec_specialized_for
methods.description: Type trait to mark specific specializations for different integer types.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Load unaligned data into SIMD vector registers.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Store SIMD vector data into memory, with support for partial store based on count.

methods.name: Vectorized<T> blend(Vectorized<T> a,Vectorized<T> b)
methods.description: Blend two vectors based on a compile-time mask.

methods.name: Vectorized<T> arange(T base=0,step_t step=static_cast<step_t> (1))
methods.description: Generate sequential vector values starting from a base, with optional step.

methods.name: neg
methods.description: Negate the vector elements via subtraction from zero.

methods.name: Vectorized<int16_t> abs() const
methods.description: Compute absolute value of vector elements.

methods.name: compare operators
methods.description: Generate comparison masks for vector elements (==, !=, >, >=, <, <=).

methods.name: reduce_add
methods.description: Sum all elements in the vector.

methods.name: reduce_max
methods.description: Find the maximum element in the vector.
